plain: To frighten someone into giving up.

webster.text: To repress or subdue courage; to intimidate; to dishearten; to check by fear of danger.

example.quote: I have seen them perform feats that would do honor to the first veterans, and submitting to what would daunt German soldiers.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 9, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
